evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce EgoPass-Bench, a benchmark for observer-relative interaction understanding in real-world egocentric video.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: EgoPass-Bench comprises 284 manually reviewed evaluation clips recorded using Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2) smart glasses and 2,201 distinct questions across five tasks assessing motion perception, interaction judgments about specified entities, and relevant-entity discovery without target cues.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across all 574 entity-discovery questions, it trails the two-person human baseline by $23.65 \pm 7.45$ percentage points (paired 95% CI), while exceeding the always-empty baseline (36.76%) by at least 18.9 percentage points.
